overview: A worldwide donation website where visitors can browse real causes and give securely online with globally used payment methods.
features: Browse causes for Nepal earthquake relief and Africa water, food and medicine
See each cause's funding goal, amount raised and progress
Donate online with a card or another globally supported payment method
Share a direct link to any cause
Public donor list with optional name and message, or give anonymously
Owner-only tools to create, edit, publish and close causes and view the donation ledger
